examples.en: He is too young to go to school alone.
examples.zh: 他太小了，不能独自去上学。

examples.en: She is old enough to look after herself.
examples.zh: 她够大了，可以照顾自己。

examples.en: The box is too heavy for me to carry.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。

examples.en: He is strong enough to lift the heavy table.
examples.zh: 他够强壮，能抬起那张重桌子。

examples.en: The water is too hot to drink.
examples.zh: 水太烫了，不能喝。

examples.en: I am tall enough to reach the top shelf.
examples.zh: 我够高，能够到最上面的架子。

examples.en: He is too short to ride the roller coaster.
examples.zh: 他太矮了，不能坐过山车。

examples.en: The soup is cool enough to eat now.
examples.zh: 汤够凉了，现在可以吃了。

examples.en: The bag is too small to hold all my books.
examples.zh: 这个包太小了，装不下我所有的书。

examples.en: She is clever enough to solve the puzzle.
examples.zh: 她够聪明，能解开这个谜题。

examples.en: He is too tired to finish his homework.
examples.zh: 他太累了，没法完成作业。

examples.en: The movie is interesting enough to watch twice.
examples.zh: 这部电影够有趣，值得看两遍。

examples.en: The ice is too thin to skate on.
examples.zh: 冰太薄了，不能在上面滑冰。

examples.en: He is brave enough to face the big dog.
examples.zh: 他够勇敢，敢面对那只大狗。

examples.en: The shirt is too small for me to wear.
examples.zh: 这件衬衫太小了，我穿不了。

examples.en: She is patient enough to teach the little kids.
examples.zh: 她够耐心，能教小孩子们。

examples.en: The story is too long to read in one day.
examples.zh: 这个故事太长了，一天读不完。

examples.en: He is rich enough to buy a big house.
examples.zh: 他够有钱，能买大房子。

examples.en: The music is too loud to hear the teacher.
examples.zh: 音乐声太大，听不见老师说话。

examples.en: The question is easy enough for everyone to answer.
examples.zh: 这个问题够简单，每个人都能回答。

examples.en: The room is too dark to read without a lamp.
examples.zh: 房间太暗，没有灯没法看书。

examples.en: She is careful enough to check every detail.
examples.zh: 她够细心，能检查每个细节。

examples.en: The panda is too cute to ignore.
examples.zh: 熊猫太可爱了，让人无法忽视。

examples.en: The bus is crowded enough to make people uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 公交车够拥挤，让人不舒服。

questions.q: The tea is _____ to drink. It's too hot.
questions.hint: too + 形容词，表示太……而不能
questions.sentence: The tea is too hot to drink.
questions.zh: 茶太烫了，不能喝。

questions.q: She is _____ to go to school. She is only five.
questions.hint: too young = 太小，否定结果
questions.sentence: She is too young to go to school.
questions.zh: 她太小了，不能上学。

questions.q: He is _____ to carry the heavy box. He is strong.
questions.sentence: He is strong enough to carry the heavy box.
questions.zh: 他够强壮，能搬动重箱子。

questions.q: The movie is _____ to watch again. It's very funny.
questions.sentence: The movie is funny enough to watch again.
questions.zh: 这部电影够有趣，值得再看一遍。

questions.q: The soup is _____ to eat. It's too salty.
questions.sentence: The soup is too salty to eat.
questions.zh: 汤太咸了，不能喝。

questions.q: He is _____ to drive a car. He is only 16.
questions.sentence: He is too young to drive a car.
questions.zh: 他太小了，不能开车。

questions.q: The classroom is _____ for all the students. It's big.
questions.sentence: The classroom is big enough for all the students.
questions.zh: 教室够大，能容纳所有学生。

questions.q: The box is _____ for me to lift. It's too heavy.
questions.sentence: The box is too heavy for me to lift.
questions.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。

questions.q: She is _____ to take care of herself. She is 18 now.
questions.sentence: She is old enough to take care of herself.
questions.zh: 她够大了，能照顾自己。

questions.q: The music is _____ to hear clearly. Please turn it down.
questions.sentence: The music is too loud to hear clearly.
questions.zh: 音乐声太大，听不清楚。

questions.q: The book is _____ for a child. It has many hard words.
questions.sentence: The book is too difficult for a child.
questions.zh: 这本书对孩子来说太难了。

questions.q: He is _____ to win the race. He runs fast.
questions.sentence: He is fast enough to win the race.
questions.zh: 他够快，能赢得比赛。

questions.q: The water is _____ to swim. It's too cold.
questions.hint: too cold = 太冷，不能游泳
questions.sentence: The water is too cold to swim.
questions.zh: 水太冷了，不能游泳。

questions.q: The chair is _____ for me to sit on. It's broken.
questions.sentence: The chair is too weak for me to sit on.
questions.zh: 椅子太不结实了，我坐不了。

questions.q: The bag is _____ to hold all the books. It's big.
questions.sentence: The bag is big enough to hold all the books.
questions.zh: 这个包够大，能装下所有的书。

questions.q: The story is _____ to make us laugh. It's funny.
questions.sentence: The story is funny enough to make us laugh.
questions.zh: 这个故事够有趣，能让我们笑。

questions.q: The room is _____ to hold a party. It's big.
questions.sentence: The room is big enough to hold a party.
questions.zh: 这个房间够大，能开派对。

questions.q: The tea is _____ to drink. It's cool now.
questions.sentence: The tea is cool enough to drink.
questions.zh: 茶够凉了，可以喝了。

questions.q: He is _____ to solve the problem. He is smart.
questions.sentence: He is smart enough to solve the problem.
questions.zh: 他够聪明，能解决这个问题。

questions.q: The road is _____ to drive fast. It's too narrow.
questions.sentence: The road is too narrow to drive fast.
questions.zh: 路太窄了，不能开快车。

questions.q: The girl is _____ to reach the top shelf. She is tall.
questions.sentence: The girl is tall enough to reach the top shelf.
questions.zh: 这个女孩够高，能够到最上面的架子。

questions.q: The apple is _____ to eat. It's too sour.
questions.sentence: The apple is too sour to eat.
questions.zh: 苹果太酸了，不能吃。

questions.q: The boy is _____ to join the army. He is 18.
questions.sentence: The boy is old enough to join the army.
questions.zh: 这个男孩够年龄，能参军了。

questions.q: The shirt is _____ to wear. It's too tight.
questions.sentence: The shirt is too tight to wear.
questions.zh: 这件衬衫太紧了，穿不了。

questions.q: The park is _____ to play in. It's clean.
questions.sentence: The park is clean enough to play in.
questions.zh: 公园够干净，可以玩。

questions.q: The homework is _____ to finish in an hour. It's easy.
questions.sentence: The homework is easy enough to finish in an hour.
questions.zh: 作业够简单，一小时内能完成。

questions.q: The bus is _____ to take us home. It's late.
questions.sentence: The bus is too late to take us home.
questions.zh: 公交车太晚了，不能送我们回家。

questions.q: The panda is _____ to see in the zoo. It's rare.
questions.sentence: The panda is rare enough to see in the zoo.
questions.zh: 熊猫够稀有，值得在动物园看。

scenes.title: too…to：太……而不能
scenes.lead: 当表示“太……以至于不能做某事”时，用 too + 形容词 + to do。
scenes.sentence: He is too tired to finish his homework.
scenes.zh: 他太累了，没法完成作业。

scenes.title: enough to：足够……可以做
scenes.lead: 当表示“足够……以至于能做某事”时，用 形容词 + enough + to do。注意 enough 在形容词后面。
scenes.sentence: She is careful enough to check every detail.
scenes.zh: 她够细心，能检查每个细节。

scenes.title: 易错点：enough 的位置
scenes.lead: enough 必须放在形容词后面，不能说 enough old，要说 old enough。
scenes.sentence: He is old enough to go to school.
